title: Harness completion status and hosted-evidence attachment
note: HS1-HS15: the derived status refusing COMPLETE (stale or absent evidence, residual gaps, classifications, unclassified elements, audits, facts, external-blocker attribution, stale documents, --require-complete); AE1-AE6: the evidence tool refusing runs that are not green on exactly the commit, and digesting the commit's tree rather than the working tree.

mutations.name: HS1_blocked_whenever_anything_unsatisfied
mutations.find: elif all(u["external"] for u in unsatisfied):
mutations.rationale: an actionable gap is reported as an external blocker

mutations.name: HS2_stale_evidence_counts
mutations.find:
return st["classification"] == CM.COMPLETE and \
        st["evidence"] == CM.EV_COVERS and st["residual_gaps"] == 0
mutations.rationale: evidence that predates the implementation, or was never run, satisfies a row

mutations.name: HS3_residual_gaps_ignored
mutations.rationale: a complete row with an open residual gap satisfies the contract

mutations.name: HS4_classification_ignored
mutations.rationale: a row below complete satisfies the contract

mutations.name: HS5_unlisted_element_ignored
mutations.rationale: a stack element the contract does not mention escapes classification

mutations.name: HS6_missing_audit_is_clean
mutations.rationale: an audit that was not run counts as clean

mutations.name: HS7_legacy_label_not_required
mutations.rationale: the legacy PASS count may lose its LEGACY_QTA_ONLY label

mutations.name: HS8_trained_flagship_accepted
mutations.find:
"ok": fl["real_weights_allocated"] is False
            and fl["large_model_trained"] is False,
mutations.rationale: a status saying the large model was trained passes

mutations.name: HS9_refused_states_subset
mutations.rationale: learned outputs may become VERIFIED

mutations.name: HS10_refusal_not_demonstrated
mutations.rationale: the claims record need not show the acceptance attempt refused

mutations.name: HS11_staged_element_external
mutations.rationale: a STAGED element reads as an external blocker

mutations.name: HS12_row_external
mutations.rationale: an actionable row reads as an external blocker

mutations.name: HS13_stale_document_accepted
mutations.find: if not p.is_file() or p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") != want:
mutations.rationale: a hand-edited status document passes verify

mutations.name: HS14_require_complete_ignored
mutations.rationale: --require-complete passes an incomplete harness

mutations.name: HS15_absent_row_satisfies
mutations.rationale: a stack element backed by a row that does not exist is satisfied

mutations.name: AE1_any_commit
mutations.rationale: a run on another commit is recorded as evidence about this one

mutations.name: AE2_unfinished_run
mutations.rationale: an in-progress or cancelled run is evidence

mutations.name: AE3_skipped_job
mutations.rationale: a green summary over a skipped job is evidence about that job

mutations.name: AE4_no_jobs
mutations.rationale: a run listing no jobs is evidence

mutations.name: AE5_working_tree_digest
mutations.replace:
read = lambda p: (root / p).read_bytes() if (root / p).is_file() else None  # noqa: E731
    listdir = lambda p: []  # noqa: E731
mutations.rationale: the digest is taken from the working tree, stamping edits made after the run as covered

mutations.name: AE6_unknown_row
mutations.find:
if row is None:
            raise EvidenceRefused(f"no row {rid}")
mutations.rationale: a misspelt row id is silently skipped
